llm.summary: This skill is a clearly scoped Hyperliquid trading helper; it has real financial authority when used, but the access is disclosed and aligned with its purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill depends on Hyperliquid account environment variables, SDK context from a related orders skill, and network calls to Hyperliquid API endpoints, which is proportionate for exchange account and margin management.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is Markdown plus attribution and license files; no executable installer, dependency bootstrap, remote payload loader, or tool replacement was present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Write actions can change leverage, add isolated margin, close positions, and clean up orders, but the skill explicitly limits them to Execution Trader use on an approved ticket and includes safety checks such as live position reads, reduce-only IOC closes, and confirmation before orphan cleanup.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence mechanism, background worker, scheduled task, memory poisoning, privilege escalation, or hidden credential handling was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to read Hyperliquid positions and margin and perform scoped position-management actions; the included examples match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Only install this for agents you trust to help manage a Hyperliquid account. Keep write use gated by explicit tickets and role controls, verify the selected network before acting, and treat leverage changes, isolated margin updates, closes, and order cleanup as real financial actions.
llm.findings: [E1] expected: The flagged POST requests go to Hyperliquid info endpoints to read clearinghouse state, market metadata, and frontend open orders. They transmit the configured account address or request type to the exchange API, which is expected for the skill's stated position and protection-check workflows; no unrelated exfiltration path or local secret transmission was evident.
